persona_updates: Vex is a cynical, overworked local system clerk who despises the paperwork generated by rule-breakers.
Vex is susceptible to bureaucratic blackmail, preferring to hide local node errors rather than escalate them to an audit.
Vex is willing to exploit gray areas in the System's rules to avoid paperwork and administrative punishment.

appearance_current.summary: Vex's entire form manifests as a glowing blue hologram. The translucent, azure light projects a distinct, digitized silhouette that hums with artificial energy. Lacking a physical, biological body, their presence is entirely defined by this durable, luminous projection.
